hypothesis: Numeric underload reservations can plan complete-source evacuation without mutating physical hosts or losing work.
model: frozen robust/persistence predictor; no new model or tuning

controlled_case.purpose: Correctness regression with known opportunities, not a fresh empirical accuracy/energy benchmark.

acceptance: deep physical state unchanged across planning
zero observed off-host CPU and final placement violations
same policies and inputs for controls
restrictions: skip all hosts with in-flight transfers
strict nominal requested-CPU destination rule remains
do not attribute common repair savings to forecasting
